summary.text: Margaret Arney is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 18, where she took office on January 6, 2025, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican Joel Richmond.

paragraphs.text: Margaret Arney earned a high school diploma from Rufus King High School, a bachelor's degree from Harvard University and a graduate degree from the University of Chicago.
She has served as president of the Wauwatosa Neighborhood Association Council, on the Wauwatosa Senior Commission, and as vice chair of the Equity and Inclusion Commission.
Arney joined the Assembly in January 2025, and for 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Review of Administrative Rules and Transportation committees.
